ai_language_tip: Cantonese is unsupported. In Hong Kong, use English for Western/upscale spots and private clinics, Mandarin for Chinese venues; in Macau, start with Mandarin, fallback English.
english_ok: often — Hong Kong hotels, Western dining, Central/TST venues, and private clinics speak fluent English; Macau resorts do too, neighborhood shops less so.
politeness: Polite, brisk, and businesslike; skip lengthy pleasantries, address staff courteously, use Mr./Ms. or 先生/小姐, and confirm details quickly.
name_tip: Surname plus Mr./Ms. (Mr. Chan / 陳先生) works for dining and salons; private clinics require full English or Chinese name matching ID, often spelled out.
phone_tip: 8-digit numbers without area codes: HK mobile 9123 0100, landline 2123 0100; Macau mobile 6612 0100, landline 2812 0100. Read 4-4; WhatsApp/SMS confirmations common.
time_tip: 12-hour clock in speech, 24-hour in messages; clarify first or second dinner seating (頭輪/尾輪) and repeat date with weekday.
number_tip: In Hong Kong English, repeated digits use 'double/triple' (double eight); in Mandarin, use standard 一 rather than mainland yāo with HK staff.
avoid_calling: Avoid peak lunch (12:30–14:00) and dinner (19:00–20:30); many private clinics close for lunch around 13:00–14:30.
closed_days: Many clinics close Sunday afternoons and public holidays; Typhoon Signal No. 8+ (八號風球) or Black Rainstorm suspends most non-emergency businesses.
booking_channels: Restaurants use OpenRice, Bistrochat, SevenRooms, Chope, or WhatsApp; cha chaan teng are walk-in only; HK public clinics require HA Go app or keypad IVR.
voice_menu: HK Hospital Authority clinics, hospital groups, and corporate hotlines use keypad IVR; independent restaurants, private clinics, salons, and local shops answer live.
callback_habits: Restaurants, clinics, and salons confirm via WhatsApp or SMS and often reconfirm 24h ahead.

restaurant.before_dialing_zh: 茶餐廳、冰室、燒味店與大排檔多數不收訂位（只收現場等位）；西餐與中環店家建議講英文。
usually_asked: Date and arrival time (邊日、幾點)
Party size splitting adults, children, and high-chair/stroller needs (幾位大人小朋友、要唔要BB凳/擺BB車)
First or second dinner seating slot and indoor/outdoor preference (頭輪定尾輪、坐室內定戶外)
Surname with title and 8-digit mobile/WhatsApp number (貴姓、WhatsApp或聯絡電話)

may_come_up.what: Strict 90- or 120-minute table return time (限時交枱) and 10–15 minute hold limit
Credit card hold or deposit link sent via Bistrochat/SevenRooms/WhatsApp (留位費/落訂連結)
Corkage fee, cake-cutting fee, or private room minimum charge (開瓶費/切餅費/廳房最低消費)
Casual eateries (茶餐廳/冰室/燒味店) refusing bookings, walk-in queue only

sensitive_asked.what: Credit card number over the phone
Immediate FPS or PayMe transfer (轉數快/PayMe落訂)
Email address for SevenRooms or hotel booking link

clinic.before_dialing_zh: 香港公立普通科門診只能用 HA Go App 或按鍵語音輸入身份證預約，AI 僅能代約私家診所與牙醫。
usually_asked: New patient or follow-up status (新症定舊症)
Consultation specialty, symptoms, or dental treatment needed (睇咩科、洗牙定牙痛)
Preferred doctor, date, and appointment slot (指定醫生、邊日幾點)
Patient full name matching ID and 8-digit mobile number (病人全名、聯絡電話)

may_come_up.what: HK public clinics (醫管局普通科門診) require keypad IVR + HKID or HA Go app, no live phone booking
Specialist clinics asking whether patient has a doctor's referral letter (有無醫生轉介信)
Asking whether paying cash or using corporate medical card/health voucher (用醫療卡/醫療券定自費)

sensitive_asked.what: HKID or Macau BIR number (身份證號碼), birth date, or medical insurance card number (醫療卡號碼)

beauty.before_dialing_zh: 美容美甲小店極常要求改用 WhatsApp 確認並以 PayMe 或轉數快先付訂金。
usually_asked: Exact treatment: cut/color, gel nail removal, facial, or massage duration (剪染電、拆甲gel甲、做幾耐)
New client trial versus package holder and preferred stylist/therapist (新客定用套票、有無指定師傅)
Appointment date, time, and number of guests (邊日幾點、幾位)
Client name and WhatsApp-reachable phone number (稱呼、WhatsApp電話)

may_come_up.what: Requesting switch to WhatsApp to confirm and pay deposit via PayMe/FPS (WhatsApp落訂確認)
Asking whether deducting from prepaid package or using first-trial offer (扣套票定新客試做價)

sensitive_asked.what: Immediate PayMe or FPS (轉數快) deposit transfer

repair.before_dialing_zh: 原廠售後熱線多有按鍵選單；街坊維修師傅多講粵語，上門服務若未寫地址 AI 會在通話中問主人。
usually_asked: Brand, model, and fault symptoms for appliance, phone, or car (牌子型號、壞咩/保養)
Warranty status and on-site visit versus shop drop-off (過保未、上門定攞去門市)
District, estate, and walk-up stairs check for home service (邊區屋苑、係咪唐樓行樓梯)
Contact name and 8-digit phone number (稱呼、電話)

may_come_up.what: On-site inspection fee (上門檢查費) or walk-up/outlying-island surcharge (唐樓/偏遠地區附加費)
Official service centers routing via keypad IVR or asking serial/invoice number

sensitive_asked.what: Full estate/building/flat address when owner omitted it
Device screen passcode or cloud account password

takeout.before_dialing_zh: 香港茶餐廳外賣電話語速極快且多講粵語，單人外送多改用 Keeta 或 foodpanda。
usually_asked: Self-pickup versus delivery and address if delivery (外賣自取定送)
Dishes, set drinks, and hot vs iced choice (叫咩餐、跟餐飲品凍定熱)
Customizations and whether paid disposable cutlery is needed (少甜少冰走青、要唔要餐具)
Pickup time and surname or phone number (幾點攞、貴姓或電話)

may_come_up.what: Takeaway box fee ($1–$2 per item) and statutory charge for disposable cutlery (外賣盒費、走塑餐具加錢)
Iced drink or special drink upgrade surcharge on set meals (凍飲加$2–$4)

sensitive_asked.what: Delivery flat address when owner omitted it
PayMe/FPS prepayment for large takeaway orders

shop_order.before_dialing_zh: 一般零售現貨僅免費留至當晚收舖，節慶食品或限量貨品多要求先落訂。
usually_asked: Product name, exact model/color/size, and quantity (貨品型號顏色尺碼、幾件)
Target branch location to check inventory (邊間分店攞)
Expected pickup time before same-day closing (幾時過嚟攞)
Customer surname and 8-digit phone number (貴姓、聯絡電話)

may_come_up.what: Same-day hold limit without deposit (只留即日收舖前)
Inter-branch stock transfer wait or deposit required for cakes/seasonal hampers (調貨/落訂留貨)

sensitive_asked.what: FPS/PayMe or card deposit to reserve limited merchandise

change.before_dialing_zh: 西餐與酒店訂位若綁定信用卡留位費，24–48 小時內改期或取消可能被扣費。
usually_asked: Original booked date and time (原本約咗邊日幾點)
Booked name and 8-digit phone number (留咗咩名同電話)
Original party size or service item to confirm record (原本幾位或約咩項目)
Whether canceling outright or moving to a new date/time (取消定改去幾時)

may_come_up.what: Card-hold or deposit penalty inside 24–48 hour cancellation window (過時取消扣留位費)
OpenRice or Chope bookings needing in-app modification by owner

sensitive_asked.what: HKID digits or birth date to modify private hospital/clinic bookings

inquiry.before_dialing_zh: 香港街坊茶餐廳與小舖店員繁忙時只講粵語且語速極快，建議長話短說。
usually_asked: Specific question: hours, typhoon/holiday status, walk-in queue, stock, or price (問咩事、有無開、使唔使等位)
Arrival time and headcount if asking live table availability (幾點到、幾位)
Exact product model, size, or branch if checking stock (邊款型號尺碼、邊間分店)
Dog size and outdoor seating request if asking pet policy (狗狗大細、坐唔坐戶外露天位)

may_come_up.what: Hong Kong law bans dogs inside indoor restaurants except guide dogs; pets allowed only on licensed outdoor patios (室內禁狗、只坐露天位)
Shopping mall parking validation spend threshold (商場泊車優惠消費額)
Typhoon Signal No. 8 or Black Rainstorm opening/reopening window (八號波/黑雨落波後幾耐開舖)

hotel.before_dialing_zh: 港澳酒店與澳門綜合度假村總機多先播按鍵選語言（粵/英/普），訂房通常需信用卡擔保。
usually_asked: Check-in and check-out dates and number of rooms (入住及退房日期、幾間房)
Adult and child count plus children's ages and baby cot/bed-guard needs (幾大幾細、小朋友幾歲、要唔要BB床)
Room category, king vs twin beds, and breakfast package (房型、大床定雙床、包唔包早餐)
Booking reference and channel if changing dates, early check-in, or luggage storage (預訂編號、邊個網訂)
Registered guest full English name matching ID/passport and contact phone (住客英文全名、聯絡電話)

may_come_up.what: Hotel PBX keypad menu for language/department before reaching Reservations or Concierge
Hong Kong plastic-free law banning free disposable toothbrushes/razors/plastic water bottles in rooms (走塑法例不免費提供即棄用品)
Extra-bed fee, late check-out charge, 10% service charge, and HK Hotel Accommodation Tax (加床費/延退費/加一及房租稅)

sensitive_asked.what: Credit card number, expiry, or CVV to guarantee room or add-ons
Passport or HKID/Macau ID number prior to check-in

activity.before_dialing_zh: 香港康文署公立體育館須用 SmartPLAY 系統預訂，不收電話訂場；Party Room 與工作室多轉 WhatsApp 收訂金。
usually_asked: Venue or activity type: karaoke, party room, BBQ pit, playhouse, or workshop (唱K、Party Room、燒烤爐定工作坊)
Date, start time, and booking duration in hours (邊日幾點、玩幾多個鐘)
Total headcount splitting adults and children (幾多位大人小朋友)
Contact name and WhatsApp phone number (稱呼、WhatsApp電話)

may_come_up.what: Party rooms, BBQ venues, and workshops requiring PayMe/FPS deposit via WhatsApp to hold booking (WhatsApp過數落訂先確認)
Karaoke chains pricing by K-lunch/happy-hour/prime-time per head plus 10% service charge (按時段人頭收費及加一)
Public sports venues (康文署場地) requiring SmartPLAY online booking only

sensitive_asked.what: Immediate PayMe or FPS transfer to lock room or court

home_service.before_dialing_zh: 水電冷氣與搬屋師傅多講粵語，必問屋苑、有無𨋢（唐樓收樓梯費）及管理處准許施工時段；地址僅主人有寫才給。
usually_asked: Service type and specs: window vs split AC horsepower, drain/lock issue, moving volume (窗口機定分體機幾匹、開鎖通渠定搬屋)
District, estate/building name, and elevator vs walk-up stairs (邊區屋苑大廈、有無𨋢定唐樓幾樓)
Preferred date and time within building management work hours (邊日幾點)
Whether exterior AC work requires bamboo scaffolding (洗唔洗搭棚維修)
On-site contact surname and WhatsApp/mobile number (貴姓、WhatsApp電話)

may_come_up.what: Asking owner to WhatsApp photos/video of AC label, lock, or furniture for quote (WhatsApp傳相報價)
Surcharges for walk-up stairs (唐樓樓梯費), outlying islands/Discovery Bay/Tung Chung, or tunnel/parking fees
Locksmith checking HKID or tenancy/utility proof on site before opening flat door

sensitive_asked.what: Full estate, block, floor, and flat address when owner omitted it
Building lobby door PIN or smart-lock passcode over the phone
PayMe/FPS deposit before dispatching technician

pet.before_dialing_zh: 香港獸醫診所英語極通；狗隻寄宿依規須出示有效針卡及漁護署狗牌晶片。
usually_asked: Service type: vet consult/vaccine, bath vs full clip, or boarding dates (睇獸醫打針、沖涼剪毛定寄宿日期)
Species, breed, weight, age, and pet's name (貓定狗、品種體重、幾歲、寵物名)
New client versus existing patient chart (新症定舊症)
Vaccination card/microchip status, coat matting, or preferred vet/groomer (齊唔齊針卡狗牌、有無打結、指定醫生)
Owner full name and mobile/WhatsApp number (主人名、電話)

may_come_up.what: Boarding facilities requiring valid vaccine card and HK AFCD dog license/microchip (有效針卡及漁護署狗牌晶片)
Surcharges for matting, ticks/fleas, or large-dog weight tiers (拆結費、杜蝨費、大狗收費)
Pet salons requesting WhatsApp PayMe/FPS deposit for weekend slots

sensitive_asked.what: Owner HKID number for boarding or surgery registration
Immediate FPS/PayMe deposit transfer

tracking.before_dialing_zh: 順豐（SF Express）、香港郵政與 HKTVmall 熱線皆有按鍵語音選單；直撥派件員手機或用 App 改派較可行。
usually_asked: Waybill, order, or repair slip number (順豐單號、訂單編號、維修單號)
Recipient or customer name and 8-digit phone number (收件人名、電話)
Delivery flat or SF Station / EF Locker code (派送地址或順豐站/智能櫃代碼)
New delivery slot, concierge drop-off, or redirect to pickup locker (改派時間、放管理處或轉自取櫃)

may_come_up.what: Courier customer hotlines requiring keypad language and waybill input before live support
Redirecting parcel to SF Locker/Station or leaving at estate concierge (轉順豐櫃自取或擺座頭管理處)

sensitive_asked.what: Smart-locker pickup PIN or SMS verification code (智能櫃取件碼)
Delivery address when owner did not provide it

customer_service.before_dialing_zh: 港澳電訊、電力煤氣、銀行信用卡及航空熱線一律先播按鍵選語言（廣/英/普）並嚴格核對本人身份證與生日，AI 無法代辦。
usually_asked: Mandatory keypad language selection (Cantonese/English/Mandarin) and multi-level IVR routing
Account holder full English/Chinese name and registered phone number (戶口持有人全名、登記電話)
HKID/Macau BIR digits, birth date, and billing address verification (身份證號碼、出生日期、地址)
Account number, PNR booking reference, or service request details (賬戶編號、機票編號)

may_come_up.what: Keypad language/menu IVR blocking call before any live representative answers
Strict privacy policy requiring account holder to speak personally on recorded line

sensitive_asked.what: HKID/BIR number, birth date, credit card digits, phone-banking PIN, or SMS OTP

transport.before_dialing_zh: 香港街頭電召的士台多只講極快粵語，英文與普通話建議改訂酒店禮賓車、跨境七人車或租車公司。
usually_asked: Immediate taxi dispatch versus pre-booked airport/cross-border MPV or car rental and time (即叫定預約、幾點用車)
Pickup estate/hotel/flight number and drop-off destination plus harbour tunnel choice (邊度上車去邊、行邊條海隧)
Passenger count, 4-seat vs 5-seat taxi or 7-seater MPV, and trunk luggage count (幾個人、幾件大行李)
Pets, wheelchair, or folding bikes incurring statutory taxi surcharges (有無寵物、輪椅、大型物件)
Passenger 8-digit phone number for driver callback (司機聯絡電話)

may_come_up.what: Statutory HK taxi fees per trunk luggage ($6), pet ($5), phone booking, and harbour/tunnel tolls (車尾箱行李費、寵物費、隧道費)
Cross-border HK–Macau/Shenzhen MPV confirming whether all passengers hold Home Return Permits vs foreign passports (過關證件種類確認)
Cantonese-only taxi radio operators hanging up quickly if non-Cantonese caller hesitates

sensitive_asked.what: Passport, Home Return Permit (回鄉證), HKID, or driving license number
PayMe/FPS deposit to hold cross-border MPV or rental car

property.before_dialing_zh: 香港地產代理普遍通英文與普通話；現場睇樓前通常須簽署俗稱「睇樓紙」的地產代理協議。
usually_asked: Estate name, tower/floor/flat or 28Hse/agency listing ID, and lease vs purchase (邊個屋苑盤、租定買)
Preferred viewing time and whether unit is vacant with key vs tenant-occupied (約幾時睇樓、吉盤有匙定約租客)
Tenant profile: headcount, family/expat professionals, and income proof readiness (幾人住、做咩職業、有無入息證明)
Target lease start date and pet ownership (幾時起租、有無養貓狗)
Viewer surname, title, and WhatsApp/mobile number (貴姓、WhatsApp電話)

may_come_up.what: Requirement to sign Property Viewing Agreement (睇樓紙) on site and standard half-month rent commission (半個月代理佣金)
Building Deed of Mutual Covenant prohibiting dogs regardless of landlord consent (大廈公契唔准養狗)
Standard HK lease terms: 2 months deposit + 1 month advance rent, 1yr fixed + 1yr flexible (兩按一上、一年死約一年生約)

sensitive_asked.what: HKID/passport number or exact salary/tax figures over the phone before viewing
Transferring holding deposit (細訂) prior to viewing

government_school.before_dialing_zh: 香港政府 1823 與各部門熱線多需先按鍵選語言；學校請假多用 eClass 等校內 App 並早上致電校務處。
usually_asked: Keypad language selection on government lines, or school general office (校務處) for student leave
Student full English/Chinese name, class, and class number (學生全名、班別、學號)
Caller's parent/guardian relationship and sick/personal leave details (家長關係、病假症狀定事假日期)
Specific government application type and resident/visa category for document checklist (辦咩手續、所需證明文件)

may_come_up.what: Government hotlines gating all calls behind keypad language selection (1 Cantonese, 2 English, 3 Putonghua)
Schools requiring parent handbook note, eClass entry, or doctor's sick-leave certificate (補家長信或醫生紙)

sensitive_asked.what: HKID/Macau BIR number, birth certificate number, or application password
